name: @mako10k/mcp-llm-generator
description: 🚀 Production-ready MCP server with advanced LLM text generation, context memory, and shared memory collaboration. Features OpenAI standard function calling, 67% token reduction optimization, personality-driven consultants, associative memory, and experimental Step3 capability awareness system for enhanced AI workflows.

scripts.status: ps aux | grep 'build-production/index.js' | grep -v grep || echo 'No processes running (will start on-demand)'
scripts.quality:check: npm run lint:strict && npm run type-check && npm run test
scripts.check:copilot-instructions: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = '.github/copilot-instructions.md'; if (!fs.existsSync(path)) { console.error('❌ copilot-instructions.md が見つかりません'); process.exit(1); } const content = fs.readFileSync(path, 'utf8'); if (!content.includes('# Copilot Instructions')) { console.error('❌ 正しいフォーマットではありません'); process.exit(1); } console.log('✅ copilot-instructions.md は正常です');"
scripts.rgf-check: npx tsc --project tools/tsconfig.json && if [ -f build/tools/rgf-checker.js ]; then mv build/tools/rgf-checker.js build/tools/rgf-checker.cjs; fi && node build/tools/rgf-checker.cjs check .
scripts.production:update: echo '🔐 Production Update Process' && echo 'This operation requires explicit user approval.' && echo 'Building for production environment...' && npm run build:production && echo '✅ Production environment updated'
scripts.deploy:restart: pkill -f 'build-production/index.js' || echo 'No existing processes found' && echo '🔄 MCP Server restarted successfully' && echo '⚠️  New process will be automatically started by VS Code MCP Client'
scripts.deploy:force: pkill -9 -f 'build-production/index.js' || echo 'No existing processes found' && npm run build:production && echo '🔄 Force deployment completed'
